title: nf-austin/scrnaseq pipeline parameters
description: End-to-end 10x scRNA-seq pipeline: Cell Ranger (count or multi/Flex) + species-aware scanpy QC.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Where the FASTQs come from and where results go.

input.description: Samplesheet CSV listing the samples to run.
input.help_text: Columns: `sample`, `fastq_dir`, `multi_config`. Populate `fastq_dir` for standard runs, or `multi_config` with `--run_flex true`. In Flex mode `sample` names the *config*; the per-sample outputs are keyed by the names Cell Ranger reports under `per_sample_outs/`, which come from the multi config. Mutually exclusive with the globs.

fastq_dirs.description: Ad-hoc alternative: a directory glob, one directory of FASTQs per sample, e.g. 'data/*'.
fastq_dirs.help_text: Standard (non-Flex) mode. The sample id is the directory's base name.

multi_configs.description: Ad-hoc alternative for Flex mode: a glob matching Cell Ranger multi config CSVs.

outdir.description: Output directory. Use an absolute path on a cluster or on cloud storage.
outdir.help_text: nf-austin/echidna consumes this pipeline's output as `<outdir>/qc/{sample}/{sample}_annotated.h5ad`.

species.description: Species. Drives the mitochondrial/ribosomal/haemoglobin gene prefixes used in QC and the auto-selected reference.

flex_version.description: Flex chemistry version; v2 is APEX. Selects the probe set when auto-downloading.

expect_cells.description: Expected number of recovered cells, passed to Cell Ranger.

mode_options.title: Pipeline mode
mode_options.description: Which Cell Ranger path runs, and optional QC steps.

run_flex.description: Run Cell Ranger multi (Flex / multiplexed) instead of count.
run_flex.help_text: Also selects which samplesheet column is required: `multi_config` when true, `fastq_dir` when false.

run_scrublet.description: Run Scrublet doublet detection during QC.

create_bam.description: Produce BAM output. Cell Ranger >= 8 requires this to be set explicitly.

reference_options.title: References
reference_options.description: Cell Ranger transcriptome and Flex probe set.

transcriptome.description: Pre-downloaded Cell Ranger reference directory. Skips the download.
transcriptome.help_text: The recommended path on HPC: the download runs inside a task and compute nodes usually have no outbound network. Fetch it once on a login node.

probe_set.description: Pre-downloaded Flex probe set CSV. Skips the download.

transcriptome_url.description: Override the auto-selected reference download URL.

probe_set_url.description: Override the auto-selected probe set download URL.

container_options.title: Container options
container_options.description: Which image the QC step runs in.

scanpy_container.description: scanpy image used by SCANPY_QC. Cell Ranger and the download steps use public images.

execution_options.title: Execution environment
execution_options.description: Cluster scheduler, image caches and bind mounts. Relevant when running on HPC.
execution_options.help_text: Use the `slurm` profile together with an engine profile: `-profile slurm,singularity`.

slurm_queue.help_text: Only used with `-profile slurm`. Left unset, no --partition flag is emitted and the cluster default applies.

cluster_options.description: Raw sbatch options appended to every job, e.g. '--qos=long'.
cluster_options.help_text: Use the `=` form for values starting with `--`, e.g. --cluster_options='--qos=long'; the space form is parsed as a bare flag.

singularity_cache_dir.description: Shared directory for pulled Singularity images.
singularity_cache_dir.help_text: Put this on shared storage the compute nodes can read. The Cell Ranger image is multi-GB and $HOME is usually quota-limited.

conda_cache_dir.description: Shared directory for created conda environments.

singularity_bind.description: Extra paths to bind into the container, comma-separated, e.g. '/mnt/gpfs,/scratch'.
singularity_bind.help_text: autoMounts only binds paths Nextflow itself resolved. Cell Ranger multi also writes absolute host paths into its patched config, so a symlinked filesystem needs the real parent bound here.

max_job_request_options.title: Maximum job request options
max_job_request_options.help_text: Cell Ranger requests 16 CPUs and 64 GB by default; it is also told --localcores/--localmem from those values.

max_cpus.description: Maximum CPUs for any single job.

max_memory.description: Maximum memory for any single job.

max_time.description: Maximum time for any single job.

help.description: Print the help message and exit.
